tagline: The Great Barrier Reef island-hopping heartland — Airlie Beach to Hamilton, Hayman and Whitehaven, all inside Pioneer II range.
summary: The Whitsundays are Australia's premier island-hopping destination: 74 islands fronting the Great Barrier Reef, anchored by Airlie Beach and the resort islands of Hamilton, Hayman and Daydream, plus the world-famous Whitehaven Beach. Today guests move by ferry (Cruise Whitsundays), seaplane and resort launches. Every core leg is short and inside Pioneer II range, the high-spend reef-tourism profile is ideal for the Navier Experience model, and a quiet, low-wake foiler is a strong fit for a sensitive marine park.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II owns the entire Whitsundays mesh — Airlie, Hamilton, Hayman, Daydream, Whitehaven and the inner reef pontoons.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) links the Whitsundays to Townsville (~120 nm) and the wider GBR coast on longer trunks.

competitive_landscape: Served by Cruise Whitsundays ferries, seaplanes and resort launches; no foiling incumbent. The quiet, low-wake profile is a strong fit for a sensitive marine park, and the high-spend reef market suits the Navier Experience model.
seasonality: Year-round destination; peak Australian winter (Jun–Oct, dry season, best reef visibility); stinger season summer; trade winds bring chop the foil rides through.
regulatory_note: Australian flag; AMSA certification; Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority (GBRMPA) permits for reef operations; resort islands control their own jetties.
